ticker.name: Nuveen California Quality Municipal Income Fund

business_summary: Nuveen California Quality Municipal Income Fund is a closed ended fixed income mutual fund launched by Nuveen Investments, Inc. The fund is co-managed by Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC and Nuveen Asset Management, LLC. It invests in the fixed income markets of California, United States. The fund invests in undervalued municipal securities and other related investments that are exempt from regular federal and California income taxes. It primarily invests in securities that are rated Baa or BBB or better by Moody's Investors Service, Inc. or Standard & Poor's, and have an average maturity of 20.96 years. The fund employs fundamental analysis with a bottom-up approach to create its portfolio. It benchmarks the performance of its portfolio against the Standard & Poor's (S&P) California Municipal Bond Index and Standard & Poor's (S&P) National Municipal Bond Index. The fund was formerly known as Nuveen California Dividend Advantage Municipal Fund. Nuveen California Quality Municipal Income Fund was formed on December 1, 1998 and is domiciled in the United States.
business_summary_ko: Nuveen California Quality Municipal Income Fund는 Nuveen Investments, Inc.가 출시한 폐쇄형 고정 수입 뮤추얼 펀드입니다. 이 펀드는 Nuveen Fund Advisors LLC와 Nuveen Asset Management, LLC가 공동 관리합니다. 미국 캘리포니아주 채권시장에 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 일반 연방 및 캘리포니아 소득세가 면제되는 저평가된 지방자치단체 증권 및 기타 관련 투자에 투자합니다. Moody's Investors Service, Inc. 또는 Standard & Poor's가 Baa 또는 BBB 이상 등급을 부여하고 평균 만기가 20.96년인 증권에 주로 투자합니다. 이 펀드는 포트폴리오를 구성하기 위해 상향식 접근 방식의 기본적 분석을 사용합니다. 이 지수는 Standard & Poor's(S&P) California Municipal Bond Index 및 Standard & Poor's(S&P) National Municipal Bond Index를 기준으로 포트폴리오 성과를 벤치마킹합니다. 이 펀드는 이전에는 Nuveen California Dividend Advantage Municipal Fund로 알려졌습니다. Nuveen California Quality Municipal Income Fund는 1998년 12월 1일에 결성되었으며 미국에 주소를 두고 있습니다.
